The Getty Family and Koch Equity Development Commit to Equity Investment of up to $533 Million in Getty Images, Reflecting Confidence in Long-Term Growth Potential


Oct 12, 2026


|[PDF](https://newsroom.gettyimages.com/en/getty-images/the-getty-family-and-koch-equity-development-commit-to-equity-investment-of-up-to-533-million-in-getty-images-reflecting-confidence-in-long-term-growth-potential/pdf)


*Getty Images Secures Support of All Major Financial Stakeholder Groups on Comprehensive Restructuring Transactions to Strengthen Balance Sheet and Drive Growth Restructuring Support Agreement Provides for Implementation of Transactions Through Expedited Prepackaged Plan of Reorganization Process Process to Address Non‑Operating Legal Liabilities While Maintaining Operational Strength No Impact on Company Operations, Employees, Contributors, Partners, Customers or Vendors; Payments Expected to Continue in the Ordinary Course*


**NEW YORK, October 12, 2026** **–**[Getty Images Holdings](https://www.gettyimages.com/) , Inc. (OTCPK: GETY) (“Getty Images” or the “Company”), a preeminent global visual content creator and marketplace, today announced that it has reached agreement with all of its major financial stakeholder groups on the terms of a comprehensive restructuring that includes a series of transactions to strengthen the Company’s balance sheet and support its future growth.


Under the Restructuring Support Agreement (“RSA”), members of the Getty Family, through certain of their affiliated entities, and affiliates of Koch Equity Development (“KED”) (together, the “Equity Investors”) have committed to invest up to $533 million of new equity, noteholders representing 83.5% of the Company’s unsecured bonds have agreed to significantly reduce outstanding debt through the retirement of $270 million of outstanding senior unsecured notes, and holders representing approximately 89% of the Company’s secured bonds and term loans, and 100% of revolving credit facility lenders have agreed to reduce interest obligations and extend debt maturities on the Company’s secured debt. The RSA is the successful culmination of collaborative discussions with key stakeholders across the Company’s capital structure. Upon completion of the restructuring, Getty Images will become a privately held company, with the Equity Investors owning 100% of the reorganized Company upon emergence.


“Getty Images is uniquely trusted around the world as the unparalleled leader in premium visual content,” **said Mark Getty, Co‑Founder and Chairman of the Board.** “This transformational transaction is underpinned by the strength of the business and the significant growth potential we see ahead. I am pleased to continue our strong partnership with Koch Equity Development and the lender groups to provide capital structure improvements that will enable us to build on our solid foundation and seize new growth opportunities.”


“Getty Images is a unique and critical source of authentic imagery for its customers,” **said Mike Harris, Senior Managing Director and Co‑Head, Koch Equity Development.** “We remain confident in the company’s future and fully support this transaction alongside the Getty family. This equity investment will provide Getty Images with a firm financial foundation and greater flexibility to continue investing in its employees, customers, contributors, and future growth.”


“Over more than 30 years, Getty Images has operated an extremely successful and highly differentiated business,” **said Craig Peters, Chief Executive Officer of Getty Images.** “Core pillars of our success are the longstanding commitment of our customers and partners, the deep expertise and creativity of our team and content contributors, and the uniqueness of our archive. This transaction speaks to another pillar: the steadfast support of the Getty family, Koch Equity Development, and our lenders. Their commitment to achieving this transaction and an enhanced balance sheet will enable us to accelerate investment into the business and better position Getty Images for long‑term success.”


To implement the transactions provided for in the RSA, the Company plans to solicit approval of the agreed‑upon plan of reorganization (the “Plan”), which implements its terms, in the coming days and subsequently commence a prepackaged Chapter 11 filing process in the coming weeks. The requisite majority of creditors have committed to vote in favor of the Plan. The filing will be limited to certain of the Company’s U.S. entities. Getty Images intends to move through the process, which will address the Company’s non‑operating legal liabilities while maintaining its operational strength, on an expedited basis. The restructuring is expected to be completed by year end.


Through the process, Getty Images will continue to operate in the normal course, supported by financing from KED of up to $143 million to fund the restructuring, as well as cash generated from ongoing operations. Under the Plan, vendors will be unaffected and paid in full in the ordinary course of business. There is no anticipated impact on content contributors, partners, customers, or employees across the Company’s worldwide network.


The RSA and related disclosure materials are available[here](https://investors.gettyimages.com/news-events/events-presentations) . Additional details regarding the RSA will be provided in the Company’s Form 8‑K to be filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.


**Advisors**
Simpson Thacher & Bartlett and Cole Schotz P.C. are serving as counsel, Guggenheim Securities, LLC is serving as investment banker, Alvarez & Marsal North America, LLC is serving as financial advisor, and Kekst CNC is serving as strategic communications advisor to the Company. Gibson, Dunn & Crutcher LLP is serving as legal counsel and Houlihan Lokey Capital, Inc. is serving as investment banker to the ad hoc group of secured creditors. Jones Day is serving as legal advisor, and Rothschild & Co is serving as financial advisor to KED. Paul, Weiss, Rifkind, Wharton and Garrison LLP is serving as legal advisor, and Moelis & Company LLC is serving as financial advisor to members of the Getty Family, through certain of their affiliated entities.


**About Getty Images**
Getty Images (OTCPK: GETY) is a preeminent global visual content creator and marketplace that offers a full range of content solutions to meet the needs of any customer around the globe, no matter their size. Through its[Getty Images](http://www.gettyimages.com/) ,[iStock](https://www.istockphoto.com/) and[Unsplash](https://unsplash.com/) brands, websites and APIs, Getty Images serves customers in almost every country in the world and is the first‑place people turn to discover, purchase and share powerful visual content from the world’s best photographers and videographers. Getty Images works with over 600,000 content creators and over 360 content partners to deliver this powerful and comprehensive content. Each year Getty Images covers more than 160,000[news](http://www.gettyimages.com/editorialimages/news) ,[sport](http://www.gettyimages.com/editorialimages/sport) and[entertainment](http://www.gettyimages.com/editorialimages/entertainment) events providing depth and breadth of coverage that is unmatched. Getty Images maintains one of the largest and best privately‑owned[photographic archives](http://www.gettyimages.com/editorialimages/archival) in the world with millions of images dating back to the beginning of photography.


Through its[best‑in‑class creative library](https://www.gettyimages.com/creative) and[Custom Content](https://www.gettyimages.com/enterprise/custom-content) solutions, Getty Images helps customers elevate their creativity and entire end‑to‑end creative process to find the right visual for any need. With the adoption and distribution of generative AI technologies and tools trained on permissioned content that include indemnification and perpetual, worldwide usage rights,[Getty Images](https://www.gettyimages.com/ai) and[iStock](https://www.istockphoto.com/ai) customers can use text to image generation to ideate and create commercially safe compelling visuals, further expanding Getty Images capabilities to deliver exactly what customers are looking for.


For company news and announcements, visit our[Newsroom](https://newsroom.gettyimages.com/) .


**About Koch Equity Development**
Koch Equity Development is the principal investment and acquisition arm of Koch, Inc. ("Koch"), one of the largest privately held businesses in America. Since 2012, KED has deployed more than $40 billion in equity investments and acquisitions. With revenues that have exceeded $125 billion, Koch companies employ about 130,000 people worldwide, with nearly half of those in the United States.
